children: The CBI retail sales balance fell to -55 in September 2026 from -48 in August, the lowest in five months and missing market forecasts of -50.
Retailers reported a sharper annual decline in sales, with sales judged increasingly poor for the time of year as weak consumer sentiment weighed on demand.
Online retail sales dropped to -68 from -43, the fastest decline since October 2023.
Retail orders placed with suppliers also plunged to -62 from -29, marking the steepest fall since the survey began in 1983, suggesting retailers are responding to weaker demand by cutting purchases.
Total distribution sales, including wholesale and motor trades, declined faster, with the balance falling to -36 from -27.
Looking ahead, retailers expect sales to fall at a slower but still rapid pace in October, while online sales and supplier orders are forecast to remain deeply negative.
Stock levels relative to expected sales remained below their long-run average.

title: UK Retail Sales Worse than Expected: CBI
